exclude_speakers: Every speaker in either training or validation of the fixed 40,000-clip study; enforce across MNSC PART1/PART2
exclude_recordings: Entire 40k study and previous 9,000-clip benchmark: normalized source IDs, source coordinates, available raw/PCM hashes and speaker-transcript pairs
preparation: Mono 16 kHz; 40 dB RMS silence trim with 100 ms edge padding; retain 3–6 seconds after trimming (reject outside range); normalize to -20 dBFS RMS with 0.99 peak limit; PCM16 FLAC then decode for both feature branches
selection: No model scores used. Seeded speaker round-robin over eligible candidates; maximum 30 clips per speaker per MNSC group and 10 per Common Voice speaker. MNSC candidates from seeded source-shard order. Common Voice candidates use local prepared reserves followed by local CV26 archive order until at least 4,500 eligible candidates; no accent quotas.
models: The same four saved calibrated artifacts as Performance_Comparison_9000_20261029; verify hashes before use
primary_comparison: Fusion SVM minus Whisper SVM balanced accuracy
intervals: 2,000 paired whole-speaker bootstrap draws within class; seed 42; fitted models fixed
scope: New recordings and speakers unseen during fitting; original test speakers may recur, so this is not independent of the study test. Corpus/class confounding remains. No claim about absence from Whisper pretraining.
